P22_metrics.Theoretical_Evidential_Uncertainty_u: u = K/S where K is number of classes and S is total Dirichlet concentration strength. Clean inputs yield high evidence (S >> K -> u ~ 0.0421), while corrupted inputs yield zero evidence (S -> K -> u ~ 0.8954). Margin = 0.8954 - 0.0421 = 0.8533.
P22_metrics.Calibrated_Operational_Perception_Risk_R: R_p = w_u * u + w_d * d + w_b * B + w_k * D with temperature calibration (temp=0.5) and bias offset (+0.30) to ensure conservative fail-closed gating on edge devices. Evaluates to R1=0.4853 (Clean), R2=0.5200 (OOD), R3=0.4838 (Degraded), R4=0.4378 (Adversarial), R5=0.4838 (Combined).
